name: Repeated failed logons for a single account from one external address
description: Lab rule 1 of 5. The 365 day window is a lab-only concession, because this lab ships historical data. A production deployment of this rule would use a short window and would alert on the shape of the traffic rather than on one address. Scoped to a single external address on purpose so the result is unambiguous, and left without a threshold so that every matching event arrives as its own alert. This is the only high severity alert in the lab that is not noise, and it fires on a single record.
query: event.code: 4625 and event.outcome: failure and source.ip: "198.51.100.37"
